answer_4.quote: We conducted a manual pairwise evaluation to assess whether the clarified or original utterances more clearly conveyed the intended relation types with their dependent utterances... One PhD candidate and two graduate students, experience in annotating discourse relations... independently assessed whether the clarified or original utterances more clearly conveyed the intended relation types...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to compare each clarified utterance with its original version and judge which one more clearly conveyed the intended discourse relation type.
